original.title: The Stanford Question Answering Dataset, SQuAD v2.0 dev-v2.0.json

derivative.attribution: ChatSOP reference annotations, SOP targets, scoped ontology and paraphrases authored by an LLM coding assistant on 2026-09-27

oracle: Author-enumerated tuples from exact paragraph quotes; not generated by the SOP solver or upstream SQuAD answer spans. UNKNOWN indicates absence of supporting or explicit negative evidence, not falsehood.
limitations: Bounded historical passages and manually selected assertions, not exhaustive document understanding.
LLM annotation has no human sign-off or verified model identity.
No independence claim about pretrained knowledge; suite is only independently authored relative to the synthetic curriculum.
Upstream SQuAD answerability labels are not SOP gold.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: When were the Normans in Normandy?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Giving their name to Normandy in the 10th and 11th centuries is not a complete interval of residence.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: What century did the Normans first gain their separate identity?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: First-half-of-10th-century emergence is historical temporal language; this limited suite has no faithful temporal target for that event.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: Who gave their name to Normandy in the 1000's and 1100's
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: The source says 10th and 11th centuries, not 11th and 12th; do not silently repair the false premise.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: What is France a region of?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Reverses Normandy-is-a-region-in-France; no country containing France is established.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: Who did King Charles III swear fealty to?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Reverses the raiders→King Charles III fealty role; no negative claim about the king follows.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: When did the Frankish identity emerge?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: The paragraph dates Norman, not Frankish, identity.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: Who was the duke in the battle of Hastings?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: William is called duke and his expedition led to the conquest at Hastings; no claim that he personally fought at the battle.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: Who ruled the duchy of Normandy
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Richard I is mentioned in a principality-forging clause, not as an exhaustive ruler answer.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: What type of major impact did the Norman dynasty have on modern Europe?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Source scope is medieval Europe, not modern Europe.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: Who was famed for their Christian spirit?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: The source says Christian piety and martial spirit, not the asserted phrase.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: Who assimilted the Roman language?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Text says Normans adopted Gallo-Romance; “Roman language” changes the object.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: Who ruled the country of Normandy?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Normandy is a duchy/region, not a country in the cited paragraph.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: What principality did William the conquerer found?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Principality of Antioch is attributed to Bohemond I, not William.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: What name comes from the English words Normans/Normanz?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: The source calls Normans/Normanz French words, not English source words.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: When was the French version of the word Norman first recorded?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Only the Medieval Latin record is dated; French recording time is unstated.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: When was the Duchy of Normandy founded?
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Beginning as a fiefdom in 911 is not an exact founding instant under the available temporal profile.

rejected_scaffold_questions.question: What river originally bounded the Duchy
rejected_scaffold_questions.reason: Text distinguishes Epte in the offered lands and Seine in area/extension; no unambiguous original single river boundary.
